worldFact.fact: With an officially recorded low of -67.7°C (-89.9°F), Oymyakon holds the Guinness World Record as the coldest permanently inhabited settlement on Earth. Its 500 residents routinely leave car engines running continuously for months because motor oil freezes solid at -50°C.
